_README: HAND-EDITABLE FILE. REPLAY DESK prints these on the event tape when replay time passes `date` + `time`.
Edit, correct or add entries freely; the app re-reads this file on every page load. Keep it valid JSON.
date: YYYY-MM-DD and time: HH:MM are Chicago wall-clock time (America/Chicago, CT).
type: EIA | EIA-NG | API | HORMUZ | MACRO | OTHER.  pause: true makes the replay auto-pause when the time hits (EIA and API by default).
products: which products the item is shown for (omit or [] = all).

time_precision: 'exact' = scheduled release time; 'approx' = the story broke around then. Items timestamped before 07:00 CT print at the session open; items after 14:30 CT print at the NEXT session's open as 'since prior close'.

class (REQUIRED on every entry): 'real' = a real driver; 'noise' = a RED HERRING authored for training, not a real headline. The app never shows the class, source, url or autopsy_note during a session: every item renders identically. They are revealed only in the post-session TAPE AUTOPSY.

noise entries also need implies: 'up' | 'down' (the direction the herring tempts you to trade; used for BAITED detection) and may carry herring_type a-f and autopsy_note (why it is a herring). Never write the word 'noise' or any hint in a headline.
Keep entries sorted by date, time, then headline text, so file order says nothing about class.

Provenance of real entries: EIA times and inventory figures were checked against eia.gov. Items whose source lists a publication were found in press coverage at build time. Items whose source is 'Desk owner's notes' (including the API figures, Fed, GDP/PCE, jobs, election and settle-level items) were supplied by the desk owner and were NOT independently verified by the build.
The trading engine never reads prices from this file. Prices come only from the bar files in /data.
